title: Disintegrator Repair Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.419TH CSB.W6QM MICC-FT DRUM
description_text: The contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, and OEM-certified technical services to perform one-time maintenance and repair on the SEM Disintegrator Model 23/4 located in Building 4486, Fort Drum, NY. Work includes installation of OEM V-belts, replacement of OEM cutting knives, and a full OEM maintenance inspection. All work shall be performed by SEM-certified or SEM-authorized technicians and completed no later than 30 April 2026.
